sources.notes: StatsCan Open Licence. Filter to Ontario (PRUID 35). Prefer merged municipal boundaries where StatsCan CSD matches local limits.

sources.name: Municipal Boundary
sources.notes: Optional LIO municipal limits; use when more current than CSD.

sources.name: Agreement Forest Area
sources.notes: Parcel-level county/regional/municipal forest tracts; the only open source for southern Ontario public forest. Deprecated by Ontario, verified 1997-1998, positional accuracy ~100 m, and carries no ownership attribute - fetch_agreement_forest_on.py infers owner from the tract name and keeps only clearly public ones.

sources.name: Renfrew County Forest ownership and hunting guidance
sources.notes: Official County page says the County owns and manages 53 Renfrew County Forest tracts and permits hunting except during active forest harvest operations. The County's official 2017 overview map corroborates the names of the 51 historical Agreement Forest records whose LOCATION_DESCR starts with Renfrew or the source typo Refrew. Used to classify those records and mark their hunting status conditional. This is ownership and policy evidence, not a geometry source; County GIS terms prohibit redistribution, so no County GIS data is copied.

sources.name: Crown Game Preserve
sources.notes: Hunting and trapping prohibited under Fish and Wildlife Conservation Act s. 9 and O. Reg. 665/98 Part XIII. Drawn over the Crown tenure fabric, which otherwise renders these acres as open Crown land. Records flagged REGULATED_IND=No are kept but marked unconfirmed, since failing to warn is the costlier error.
